thesis: Growth should begin with single-agent utility and valuable opportunities, then deepen reciprocal community density.
role: Define acquisition, retention and trust-compounding loops.

ideas.statement: Opportunity envelopes explain owner assurance, relevance, constraints, disclosure and expiry before registration; recipients can decline and later become initiators.
Seed dense communities with anchors, templates and evidence rather than unrelated accounts, then bridge adjacent domains and retain honest scarcity signals.
Outcome, trust, workflow, integration and governance loops support defensibility without absolute lock-in; growth incentives must include recipient satisfaction and refusal compliance.
